topicName: Explain the use of the 'this' keyword.
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Explain the use of the 'this' keyword."},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"The 'this' keyword refers to the current object in a method or constructor. It's used to access the object's members (variables and methods) and to distinguish between instance variables and local variables with the same name."}]
